---
title: "Course template"
---

Starter files for a new course website. Copy this directory to
`courses/<slug>/` and rename placeholders.

## Files

- `_quarto.yml` — course-level Quarto website configuration
- `index.qmd` — course landing page
- `metadata.yaml` — machine-readable course descriptor

## Expected surrounding structure

```
courses/<slug>/
  _quarto.yml
  index.qmd
  metadata.yaml
  glossary.qmd
  part-1/
    index.qmd
    01-<lesson-slug>/
      index.qmd
      exercise.qmd
      lab.qmd
      quiz.qmd
      summary.qmd
      assets/
  labs/
  assets/
```

The reference implementation is [`courses/pico/`](../../courses/pico/).
